subject.title: [Feature]: Support to edit system prompt template

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class user-editable overrides for OpenClaw-owned system prompt sections such as Safety, Tool Call Style, OpenClaw Control, and Self-Update?
rationale: This changes model-facing safety guidance, prompt precedence, and operator edit authority, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security boundary from the issue alone.

options.title: Approve Scoped Section Overrides
options.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, and prompt regression tests.

options.title: Keep Existing Surfaces
options.body: Reject core section overrides and document provider overlays, bootstrap files, channel prompts, and prompt hooks as the supported customization paths.

options.title: Defer To Narrower Work
options.body: Let identity-line or config-rule issues proceed independently while keeping broad Safety/template editing unresolved.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Section Overrides
recommendation.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, and prompt regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest current history on provider-owned prompt contributions and the OpenClaw-owned prompt boundary this decision would change.
